tool_args.rationale: The pilot supports gradient-dependent siphon forcing and a transient memory state, but its five endpoints are concentrated around the target horizon. The fine trajectory batch adds temporal information to separate fast memory relaxation from its coupling strength before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter coupled siphon-memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoint observations at similar horizons leave no residual degrees of freedom and may trade off the memory coupling strength against the fast time constant.
The pilot spans 1.95 in s_grad with no detected narrow-gradient collinearity, and this probe is not in the cost menu.

considered_alternatives.option: Uncoupled Kelvin–Voigt creep or stretched-exponential relaxation
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Neither model accounts for both the sink-gradient dependence and the coupled memory lag.
It does not help distinguish the parameters of the coupled dynamics.
